pokedexEntries.su: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

pokedexEntries.mo: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they’re regrown.

pokedexEntries.us: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

pokedexEntries.um: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they’re a popular item.

pokedexEntries.sw: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.

pokedexEntries.sh: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

pokedexEntries.sc: It gets into fistfights so intense that the scales on its arms peel off. Bare arms are a sign of valiance.

pokedexEntries.vi: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.
